messages.高い速度で「光電」を撒き、パッシブ「前へ出たまえ。サポートするとしよう。」で編成: A Charge supplier that spreads Photoelectricity at high Speed and uses Take the Lead. I'll Provide You Support. to distribute Charge Count to allies earlier in deployment order. At 3 or more Charge, enhanced S3 Maximum Output - Ultra High-voltage Current Discharge inflicts Rupture and Charged Sting to raise the Charge team's damage.
messages.味方への充電供給: 「前へ出たまえ。サポートするとしよう。」(憂鬱×2・嫉妬×2: **Supplying Charge to allies**: Take the Lead. I'll Provide You Support. (2 Gloom and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) adds +10 to his Charge Count at Combat Start (+5 at lower Uptie; once per battle). At "Combat End" (per the data; it likely triggers at each Turn End in practice), if his Charge Count exceeds 12, he spends up to 8 of the excess and gives half of it to 1 ally earlier than him in team order (prioritizing allies with low Charge Count). With 2 or more Gloom or Envy Resonance (3 or more at lower Uptie), allies earlier than him in team order gain +2 Charge Count next turn (+4 if his Charge is 3 or more). The recipients are (higher of Gloom or Envy Resonance − 1) allies in team order, up to 3 (1 at a Resonance of 2).
messages.編成順の注意: 自分より編成順が早い味方がいないと、超過分の分配は無効になり、共: **Team order caution**: If no ally is earlier than him in team order, the excess distribution is wasted, and the Resonance-based grant only goes to himself. The distribution stops once his Charge reaches 3 or more.
messages.光電: S2「直流インバーティング」のⅢコインで光電2(低い段階では1。充電回数: **Photoelectricity**: Coin Ⅲ of S2 DC Inversion inflicts 2 Photoelectricity (1 at lower Uptie; 3 at 3 or more Charge Count), and Coin Ⅲ of S3 also inflicts it. Photoelectricity has a maximum of 3. When the bearer takes damage, the attacker's Charge Count increases by its value (once per skill), plus 3 more if the attacker has 5 or less Charge Count. It disappears at Turn End. His Speed is 5–7.
messages.充電を育てる: 常時発動の「しぶとい生命力」で、累計で充電回数を10消費するたび: **Growing Charge**: Through the always-active Undying Persistence, he gains 1 Charge each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. At 3 or more Charge, +1 to his minimum and maximum Speed. Each skill's Coin Power rises with Charge (the effect text reads "+1/+2 Coin Power at 3/5 or more Charge," likely a tiered +1 at 3 or more and +2 at 5 or more). At 3 or more Charge, the final Coins of S2 and S3 become Unbreakable.
messages.強化S3と電荷針: 充電3以上でS3「高圧電流放電」が「出力最大-超高圧電流放電: **Enhanced S3 and Charged Sting**: At 3 or more Charge, S3 High-voltage Current Discharge becomes Maximum Output - Ultra High-voltage Current Discharge (once per turn). All Coins Unbreakable, 3 Attack Weight, and +50% damage per target fewer than its Attack Weight. With 10 or more Charge Count, it spends 10 for +1 Base Power and +2 Coin Power, then spends up to 10 more for up to +15% damage. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 3 Photoelectricity and Charged Sting equal to his Charge next turn (up to 5; 3 at lower Uptie). At 5 or more Charge, 5 Charged Sting this turn and next (3 at lower Uptie). Charged Sting increases damage taken from skills that gain or spend Charge Count by 4% per point (up to 20%), or 8% (up to 40%) for Envy skills.
messages.編成順は先頭にせず、自分より前に充電を使う味方を置く。序盤はS1・S2で充電回数: Do not put him first in team order; place allies who use Charge ahead of him. Early on, cycle Charge Count with S1 and S2, handing the excess to the allies in front while growing his own Charge to 3. Use his high Speed to land S2 first and place Photoelectricity, so allies' attacks increase their own Charge Count. Once his Charge is 3 or more, inflict Charged Sting with the enhanced S3 and follow up with allies who use Charge, especially with Envy skills. Until he reaches 3 Charge, he fights with his base power, so his start is slowish.
